service_level_definition: Fraction of periods without newly unfilled demand
cycle_note: Only complete receipt-to-receipt cycles; boundary cycles are excluded.
cost_unavailable_reason: Missing annual holding cost, ordering cost, stockout cost
turnover_note: Horizon COGS / average on-hand inventory value; requires supplied COGS and unit cost.
assumptions: Receive scheduled orders, clear old backorders, serve current demand, then review inventory position.
Static reorder point and target from the saved forecast; review once per observation period.
Orders beyond the horizon remain outstanding; no invented future demand or terminal costs.
Holding uses end-of-period on-hand stock and annual cost divided by frequency periods/year.
Ordering is charged once per placed order; shortage cost once per newly unfilled unit.
Purchasing costs and profit are excluded from total inventory operating cost.
A zero-demand path has fill rate 1 by convention; no completed cycles gives null cycle service.

sampling.method: Circular block bootstrap of centered, held-out forecast errors
sampling.assumptions: Errors remain representative of future demand. Blocks preserve local dependence only; block_size=1 assumes independent errors. Refits and pooled forecast leads limit calibration. Empirical tails cannot represent unseen extremes.
